lines.zh: 我从幽魂橡木的枝下飞过。
lines.en: I fly beneath the ghostly oak boughs.
My wings are thin enough to show light.
I glide down along the bark.

lines.zh: 我绕着那盏苍白的灯飞。
lines.en: I circle that pale lantern.
The bones under my wings are light.

lines.zh: 我从一根枯枝跳到另一根。
lines.en: I flit from one dead branch to another.
My shadow is faint in this wood.

lines.zh: 我扇翅的时候没有声音。
lines.en: My wingbeats make no sound.
I fly over pale grey moss.

lines.zh: 我落在墓碑似的石头上。
lines.en: I settle on a headstone-like stone.
I steer around the tangled vines.
I pass the tree hollow.
I fly to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 我在林子的边缘打了个转。
lines.en: I turn once at the wood's edge.
I drop to the height of the dead branches.
I fly close to the mist.
I hang from a dead branch.
The joints of my bones are very white.
There is no wind in this wood.
My wings are folded.
Mist drifts slowly beneath me.

lines.zh: 露水太重，我什么都没抓到。
lines.en: The dew is heavy and I caught nothing.
I turn my head slowly.
The light here is grey.
My teeth are small.
I wait for something to walk by.
My bones are a little cold.
You are walking in this wood.
I hang above you.

lines.zh: 你的火把把这里照得太暖了。
lines.en: Your torch makes it too warm.

lines.zh: 我骨头的颜色，你看见了吧。
lines.en: You see the colour of my bones.
The branch you broke was loud.

lines.zh: 这片林子里活的东西不多。
lines.en: Not much living here.
Do not look up too long.
I watch you from the tree.
You came into the mist carrying iron.
What are you looking for?

lines.zh: 翅骨露出来，风从洞穿过。
lines.en: The bone shows through; wind whistles through the tear.
A few small bones slip out of line.
I fly into the mist to hide.
It hurts, and I have no flesh to bleed.
I fall back a foot and catch hold.

lines.zh: 翅骨断了一节，我用另一节扇。
lines.en: One wing bone snaps; I beat with the other.
My joints are clicking.
You snapped my wing bone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀薄得透光，还撑得住。
lines.en: My wings are thin enough to see through, and they still hold.

lines.zh: 一根肋骨松了，我照样飞。
lines.en: A rib comes loose; I fly all the same.
I want that smell.

lines.zh: 我朝那点热扇了两下翅。
lines.en: I beat twice toward that warmth.
You hold it higher than my branch.
This is heavier than a bug.
Is there any left?
It is dry in my mouth.
Keep your hand still.
These crumbs are not enough.
You bumped the branch I hang on.
I dart into the mist.
The bump rattles a few small bones.
This frame of mine cannot hurt you.
I skim past your ear.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We touched and neither spoke.
I hang back on that dead branch.

lines.zh: 你的肩碰掉了我的翅膜。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my membrane.
These branches are brittle.
I retreat to the hollow.

lines.zh: 这副骨架撑不起什么事。
lines.en: This frame cannot support much.
Few of my kind in this wood.
I only fly and bite.
I tilt my head and a bone clicks.
I have little flesh left.
This season is not mine.

lines.zh: 雾里没有别的骨架愿意过来。
lines.en: No other skeleton in the mist comes near.
This frame cannot speak of such things.
I fly into the mist.
I take it and fly to the branch.
It is heavier than my bones.

lines.zh: 叼着它我飞得东倒西歪。
lines.en: Carrying it, my flight staggers.
This is harder than my bones.
I tuck it into a ghost oak hollow.
I taste it; earth.
I drop it between two stones.
It rolled off the branch.
Good; kept on the branch.
A shadow moves in the mist.
There is warmth in that direction.
Your scent is very clear.
I let go of the branch.
Only the two of us on this level.
I begin flying toward you.
My bones show white in the mist.
Did you hear my wings?
You have backed into the mist.
I have you in sight now.
I fly at your nape.

lines.zh: 你往树深处走，那里更暗。
lines.en: You walk deeper, where it is darker.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树之间换位置。
lines.en: I change position between two trees.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在雾里几乎看不见。
lines.en: My bones are nearly invisible in mist.
You look back and see only mist.
I am on the branch behind you.
I flatten my bone wings.

lines.zh: 骨翼展开，糖果留给你自己。
lines.en: Bone wings spread — keep the candy for yourself.
I dive at your neck and bite.
My teeth are fine as needles.

lines.zh: 你一拍，我翻着落进雾里。
lines.en: You swat; I tumble into the mist.
I land back on the dead branch.
My wing bones scrape your face.
You back into a trunk.
You struck the mist.
I bite its cuff.
You go; I hang back up.

lines.zh: 我从幽魂橡木的枝上出现。
lines.en: I appear on a ghostly oak branch.
The bones form first.
The mist is thick here.
I am in the upper storey of the wood.
A small white insect flies past.
First I tidy my membrane.
There is movement in the mist.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在灰光里很淡。
lines.en: My frame is faint in the grey light.
I let go of the branch slowly.
Good; let me find food.
Fire curls my membrane.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，落在苔上。
lines.en: I fall from the branch onto the moss.

lines.zh: 水浸进来，我的翅膜贴住了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and my membrane clings.
The blast throws me out of the mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过雾，钉进我的翅骨。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the mist and hits my wing bone.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的骨头都发凉。
lines.en: That force chills my bones.

lines.zh: 雾里没有虫子，我越来越空。
lines.en: No insects in the mist; I grow hollow.

lines.zh: 雷光把整片林子照亮，我很显眼。
lines.en: The flash lights the whole wood; I stand out.
I fall, bone wings beating the mist.
